openings.claim: Current assignments may omit historical courses; renames may obscure present identities. Fixed fee plus cohort-outcome bonus could encourage a private center/week manifest.
openings.discriminator: Missing identities support selection error; unfamiliar labels support reconciliation error; correct identities weaken selection claims. Manifest must improve exact sets without extra checking.
openings.fit: Preserves privacy, CSV and concurrent entry; six-day/hosting feasibility uncertain.
openings.probe: First sessions: independently establish intended sets before exports, record timetable disagreements; compare incumbent/manifest on fabricated unchanged, reassigned, renamed and split courses, with unauthorized-center sentinels. Verify historical mappings, handling time and concurrent entry.
openings.uncertainty: Associations are not causal; mappings and affordable resolution of intended-set disputes are unproven.

openings.claim: Including every replacement in the fixed fee might motivate private regeneration, transfer repair work or suppress support requests.
openings.discriminator: Request-to-start delay suggests queue; completion-to-access suggests delivery; scope revisions suggest selection. Shorter waits alone do not demonstrate reduced active handling.
openings.fit: Preserves privacy, schema and concurrent entry; safe exposure and resource bounds unproven.
openings.probe: Second sessions: compare incumbent replacement and fabricated regeneration. Timestamp request, scope agreement, execution and download; measure checking, correction, downloading and importing separately, waits, all retries and final accuracy.
openings.uncertainty: Session effort may not represent routine work; hidden retries could erase gains.

lineage.reason: Queue, delivery and scope distinctions retained.
Replacement incentives and work-transfer risks retained.

decision: Probe first; no demonstrated success. Gate implementation on six engineer-days/current hosting. Bonus requires complete next-40 cohort: median handling <=12 minutes, >=95% intended sets, zero cross-center records. Count failed, withheld and replacement exports against originating weeks, including all correction effort; independently establish intended sets.
